title: Pre-geometric Black Holes with Spherical Symmetry
summary: Pre-geometric Gravity investigates the non-metric features of spacetime near the Planck scale, from which the gravitational interaction arises as a low-energy effective theory via a mechanism of spontaneous symmetry breaking. With a view of amending the classical singularities found in black hole geometries, in this work we study pre-geometric black hole configurations with spherical symmetry, and present exact solutions for different pre-geometric theories in vacuum via the correspondence principle.
